links.outcome: Calibration of AI scores on local population (Brier score, ECE, score range)
links.effect: Brier 0.3621 (null 0.0472), ECE 0.564; scores compressed to 0.52–0.72; discrimination preserved (AUROC 0.9583); threshold 0.6258 derived post hoc.
links.quote: Brier score was 0.3621 (null Brier 0.0472) and ECE was 0.564, confirming calibration failure due to score compression (range 0.52–0.72) despite preserved discrimination.

links.outcome: Local diagnostic accuracy versus radiologist reference standard in prospective shadow-mode
links.effect: Sensitivity 95.12%, specificity 77.2%, AUROC 0.9583, NPV 99.67%, PPV 17.89%; calibration failed despite preserved discrimination.
links.quote: The DenseNet-121 algorithm demonstrated high sensitivity and excellent discrimination for chest radiograph triage in a Nepali health-assessment population, supporting its potential as a rule-out tool (NPV 99.67%).

screen.reason: This prospective shadow-mode study evaluated an off-the-shelf chest X-ray deep learning tool on live clinical data in Nepal, specifically measuring calibration drift/score compression and the role of shadow-mode pre-deployment validation.

primary.practice: shadow-mode testing and local calibration assessment
